title: Moui Corpus Order File
description: The inbox's second input type, beside asserts. A closed action list so the inbox cannot drift into a command bus. Both actions are in the enum from day one — the contract is closed, not grown later. `reprocess` validates here but the engine refuses to execute it until a later step; that refusal is an explicit 'not yet implemented', never an 'unknown action'.

from.description: reprocess only: the stage to re-run from; must name a stage in the document's own entry list (validated when reprocess lands).
